about: Scored events. omen: chaos / polarization / economic (1-10). clio: closest historical precedent, precedent_match (1-10), institutional resistance (1-10). systems: push on each system, -3..+3 (+ = toward change, - = toward status quo). Rubric in ORACLE.md section 3.
